notes.title: 🇺🇦 Ukrainian and 🇷🇺 Russian translations added, now supporting 9 languages!
notes.content:
🎉 Update Alert!
I'm happy to announce that Bedroom Battlegrounds now supports 9 languages in total:
🇬🇧 English | 🇵🇱 Polish | 🇩🇰 Danish | 🇪🇸 Spanish | 🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese | 🇵🇹 Portuguese | 🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese | 🇺🇦 Ukrainian | 🇷🇺 Russian

Play in your language today and take your battles global! 🌟
- WCHC

notes.title: Chinese translation!
notes.content:
Hello

notes.title: Portuguese localization now supported!
notes.content:
Hello!
Another small update including:
- the game is now fully translated into Portuguese and Brazilian Portuguese!
- small bug fixes

Hope you enjoy,

notes.title: Spanish has entered the battle!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Another small update, this time bringing the joy of playing to Spanish speaking people.
Additionally a couple smaller fixes have been included.

We're gaining momentum, more languages still this week!

Hope you enjoy!
- WCHC

notes.title: Danish translation, persistent settings
notes.content:
Hi all,
Another quick update, this time with:
- Full Danish translation, thanks to Nikolaj P. Pagh!
- Settings will now be saved to your local files automatically whenever you do any changes in the Settings menu and then loaded every time you start the game.
- You can reset settings to default.
- Demo is now fully aligned with the full version, except for some of the additional content reserved for full version.

Enjoy the game!
-WCHC

notes.title: Localization support and partly Polish language translation
notes.content:
Hi,
A couple small changes!
- localization support,
- you can now change the language in the settings between English and Polish,
- the game is partly translated into Polish - there are still missing pieces which will come in the next release soon,
- support for more languages will come soon.

Enjoy!
-WCHC

notes.title: 🎉 It's Time to Rally the Troops! Bedroom Battlegrounds Is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
Step into a world where imagination knows no bounds! Bedroom Battlegrounds, our brand-new turn-based strategy game, has officially launched today. 🎮

🌟 What’s in Store for You?

Command your own army of toy soldiers, vehicles and buildings.
Explore and fight across a vibrant bedroom battlefield, navigating terrains like toy boxes, desks, and stacks of books.
Outsmart your opponents with clever strategies and unique unit abilities.


Relive the joy of childhood while challenging your tactical skills. Whether you're climbing onto grandma's favourite armchair for a vantage point or ambushing enemies from behind a stack of comic books, every decision matters.

👉 Ready to relive your childhood adventures? Download Bedroom Battlegrounds now and let the games begin! 🪖✨
